FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Fireball:
Inflige 4 + @int + 1d8 points de dégâts

1d2 de chance de brûler la cible infligeant 3 dégâts en 3 tours
(cumulable 2 fois)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Tornado:
Inflige 2 + @int + 1d6 points de dégâts

1d2 de chance d’appliquer un effet d’air réduisant le déplacement de 2 pendant 3 tours
(cumulable 2 fois)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Frostfire:
Nécessite 1 effet de brulure ou de gel

Inflige @int +1d10 points de dégâts de feu et 4 + @sag +1d4 dégâts de froid
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FrostStrike:
Inflige 1 + @sag + 1d3 points de dégâts

1d2 de chance de geler la cible augmentant le coût de ses sorts de 1 point d’action pendant 3 tours (cumulable 2 fois)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EarthFracture:
Inflige 2X + 1d@sag points de dégâts (Xmax = 3)
1d(4-X) de chance d’appliquer un effet de terre qui réduit l’esquive de la cible de 1 
(cumulable 3 fois)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VoidAssassin:
Nécéssite 2 effets éléments différents.
+1 en critique pour cette attaque pour chaque effet appliqué sur la cible

Inflige 2@dex + 3Y + 1d2X dégâts
(Xmax = 6, Ymax = 4)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaCapture: Lorsque vous subissez des dégâts, récuperez @sag points de mana
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Incantation:
Reportez X points d’action pour le prochain tour

Xmax = @int
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicPlastron:
Nécessite 1 effet de terre ou de givre actif

Enlèvez l‘effet et la cible gagne 10 + 3*@cha points de vie temporaire pendant 2 tours
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IceWave:
Nécessite 1 effet d’air ou de givre actif sur au moins une cible

Inflige 1 + @int + 1d4 dégâts de tonnerre et 1 + @sag + 1d6 dégâts de froid sur toutes les cibles adjacentes
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Fog:
Nécessite 1 effet d’air ou de terre actif sur au moins une cible

Toutes les cibles ennemis perdent @int en critique et @sag en esquive pendant 3 tours
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FireShock:
Nécessite 1 effet d’air ou de feu actif sur une des deux cibles

Inflige 2* @int dégâts de tonerre + 2d8 dégâts de feu sur 2 ennemis maximum
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Meteor:
Nécessite 1 effet de terre ou de feu actif sur une des cibles

Inflige 2 + @sag + 1d4 dégâts de force et 1 + @int + 1d4 dégâts de feu dans un carré 2x2
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DamagePropagation: A chaque fois que vous jouez une carte qui touche une seule cible, prenez une autre cible à portée, elle subit @sag dégâts par tour pendant 3 tours
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Charge:
Charge un ennemi se trouvant à 9 cases ou moins.

Pendant 1 tour, augmente les dégâts de @dex + 1d4 et le critique de @for
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HeroicStrike:
Inflige 3 + 1d(2*@for) points de dégâts
Vous pouvez choisir de ne pas consommer votre point de mana et perdre (6-@con) points de vie à la place
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaSurge:
Regagnez le double de points de mana dépensés au dernier sort
(Coûte 1 point d’action de moins par @sag)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShieldBash: Si vous subissez des dégâts par une cible se trouvant à 6 cases ou moins, vous bondissez sur une case adjacente à elle (la plus proche de vous) et vous lui infligez @cha+1d3 points de dégâts
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Hemorrhage: Inflige 2+1d3 dégâts et fait saigner la cible lui infligeant @for dégâts supplémentaires par tour pendant 2 tours.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RageSurge: Sacrifiez 3 + @con points de vie et récupérez 1 point(s) de mana, vos dégâts sont augmentés de @con pendant 1 tour
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BladeCharging:
Vous chargez de X votre attaque, le chargement est conservé après votre tour.
Lorsque vous atteignez 12 points de charge, votre prochaine attaque sera doublée en dégâts et vous defaussez cette carte
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Sharpening:
Augmente de 2X le critique jusqu’a la fin du prochain tour
(Xmax = @cha)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ArmorReinforcement:
Récupérez 1 point de vie au début de chaque tour
(dure @con tours)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BladeWhirlwind:
Vous chargez de X votre attaque, le chargement est conservé après votre tour. Applique le sort à 8 points.
Inflige 3+1d(2*@for) points de dégâts à toutes les cibles adjacentes.
Vous pouvez utilisez 5 points de vie si pas de mana
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.TauntingStrike:
Inflige 2@cha + 1d@for points de dégâts et la cible ne peut avoir que vous comme cible à son prochain tour
Vous pouvez utilisez 4 points de vie si pas de mana
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.UltimateRage:
Augmente de 2X les dégâts infligés et subit X dégâts par tour
(Xmax = @con)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EnchantedWhip:
Inflige @dex + @sag + 1d8 dégâts
La portée est augmenté de 1
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MirrorImages: Augmente l’esquive de @dex jusqu’à être touché (non cumulable)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Shuriken: Inflige 1d6 points de dégâts et 1d3 de chance de faire saigner la cible (infligeant 3*@cha dégâts en 3 tours)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PoisonedShuriken: Inflige 1d8 points de dégâts et 1d4 de chance d’empoisonner la cible (infligeant 4*@cha dégâts en 4 tours)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SungInspiration:
Augmente le critique des alliés à portée de 1 (rejouable @cha fois)
Piochez une carte
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FeveredDance:
Augmente l’esquive des alliés à portée de 1 (rejouable @cha fois)
Piochez une carte
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DaggerCloud: Place un nuage de dague sur une cible. Il inflige X+1d8 dégâts chaque tour pendant @cha tours, X étant votre bonus de portée
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShurikenVolley: Inflige X + 1d10 dégâts à @dex cibles max à portée, X étant votre bonus de portée
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ApothecaryI:
Au choix : 
- Potion de vie : 1d4+@sag vie
- Potion d’allonge: +1 portée pdt 3 tours
- Potion de vitesse : 1+@sag déplacement pendant 3 tours
- Potion de force terrestre : réduit l’esquive de la cible de @sag pendant 3 tours.
- Potion de vent : réduit le déplacement de la cible de @sag pendant 3 tours
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EtherealPlanePassage: Echange de place avec la cible, inflige ou soigne de la distance qui sépare ces cibles + @sag (incriticable)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IllusoryStrike: Inflige @for + X + 1d6 dégâts, X étant votre bonus de portée
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaDrain: Gagne X point de mana. X étant le nombre de cible à portée. Coute @sag point d’action de moins.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.CommunicatingVessels: Transforme 1 mana en 4 d’actions ou inversement (Vous pouvez rejouer ce sort @sag fois encore ce tour ci, utilisable uniquement à votre tour, minimum 1 fois)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ApothecaryII:
Au choix : 
- Potion de vie : 1d4+@sag vie
- Potion d’allonge: +1 portée pdt 3 tours
- Potion de vitesse : 1+@sag déplacement pendant 3 tours
- Potion de feu : brule la cible infligeant 1 dégâts par tour pendant @sag tours
- Potion de gel : réduit les points d’actions de la cible de @sag pdt 3 tours
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LightEnergy:
Place this card face up in front of you; you may play it a second time for the same cost.

Deals 1 + @int + 1d4 damage or restores @int + 1d3 health.
Grants 1 zeal point when you have used both charges of the spell.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Curse:
Deals @wis damage per turn for 3 turns.

(Unavoidable, Non-critical)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicShield:
Prevents the next 2*@wis wounds on a target and increases healing by 2 while the shield is active.
(The number of wounds prevented can be stacked up to 2 times, up to 12 points.)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Exorcism:
Removes 1 beneficial or detrimental effect from a target.
This spell costs @cha action points less.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.InstantCurse:
The target that damaged you receives a curse: @cha damage per turn for 3 turns.
(Stackable up to 3 times, unavoidable, non-critical)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ArcaneExplosion:
Deals 3X + 1d(@wis * 2) damage to a cursed target, or 2X + 1d(@wis) damage to the cursed target and all adjacent targets.
(Xmax = 3)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Epiphany:
Increases healing done by @con/3.
(Stackable up to 2 times)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EmergencyHealing:
Discard X cards.

Restore @int * X health points.
(Xmax = 5)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaInfusion:
Recover 1 mana point. The spell costs nothing after the first use.
Costs @wis fewer action points on the first turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaShield:
Each time you take damage, you can recover @con health points for 1 mana point.

Reusable @wis times.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DivineShield: The target cannot lose health points until their next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LightStrike:
Deals 2*@int damage to enemies and then restores 2*@int health points to you and your allies on a second use (no cost).

(Unavoidable, non-critical)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VengefulShield:
Each time a previously chosen target takes damage from an enemy, you can also deal @int damage to the attacker.

Reusable @wis times.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EmpatheticShield:
Each time a previously chosen target takes damage from an enemy, you can restore @int health points to the target.

Reusable @wis times.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RightPunch:
Deals 1 + 1d@str damage.

You may play this card again if you have already spent 4 action points this turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LeftPunch:
Deals 1 + (@str / 2) + 1d4 damage.
You may play this card again if you have already spent 5 action points this turn before playing it.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.InhibitingCape: Remove 1 detrimental effect from yourself and you lose (2 - @con) health points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SecretWeapons: Discard X cards, dealing (X + @cha) unavoidable and non-critical damage. If this spell eliminates the target, cancel the last spell that triggered this ability.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.QuickDodge: When you take damage, recover 2*@dex health points. (Can prevent falling to 0 health points)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Conversion:
Convert X zeal points into X mana points.

(Xmax = 4 + @wis)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FlashMove: Move up to 7 + @dex spaces in one direction (without obstacles). All targets you pass through take 3 + @str + 1d6 damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ZenMeditation:
You restore (3 + @con) * X health points.
Xmax = 3
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ZealousShield:
Additional cost:
-2 action points on the next turn.

When you receive any spell, gain (2 + @cha) zeal points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PhantomBlade: Deals @dex + 1d8 damage with @str as additional critical score for this attack.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Concealment:
You are untouchable and your movement is increased by 4 until the end of your next turn.
Damage on your next turn only will be increased by 1d(@dex).

You cannot deal damage this turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.KiBreath:
Draw X cards from your deck, and gain 2X action points for this turn.

(Xmax = 4 + @cha)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Necromancy:
Pay the cost only once. The card can then be reused for free.
Increase the spell’s range by @cha.
Summon a level 1 skeleton at the chosen location.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GreenShadowBolt:
Deal (2@int) poison damage and 1d6 damage on the next turn.
Summon a level 1 skeleton on a square adjacent to the witch.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GiantSkeleton:
Summon a level 4 skeleton.
3 + (3@cha) hit points
@cha + 1d6 melee damage
Movement: 4
Acts after the witch.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SquareOfSkeletons:
Summon up to 4 level 1 skeletons on squares adjacent to the witch.
(Costs @cha fewer action points)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PowerSurge: Gain as many action points this turn as there are skeletons in play.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowExplosion: Deal (2@wis) + 1d8 psychic damage in a square area with sides of @int.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowChanneling:
No skeleton can be destroyed until your next turn.
Costs 1 fewer action point per @cha.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaInflux:
Restore 2X mana where X is your sacrifice score.

Costs 1 fewer action point per @wis.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.AgilityInflux:
Gain evasion score equal to the number of skeletons in play for 2 turns.
Costs 1 fewer action point per @wis.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BoneShield: Increase skeletons hit points by (@cha/3) (lasts 2 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LifeSurge: Restores 2@sag + 3X life to a target, where X is your sacrifice score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowForm: You lose 6-@cha hit points. Increases the witch's and skeletons' damage by @cha/3 for 1 round
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PreciseShot:
Deals @dex + 2d3 damage,
X = distance to the target, Xmin = 4
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.WeakPointStudy:
Usable only when a target dodges one of your cards: Recover the dodged card or two cards from your discard pile and add them to your hand.

Increases all damage by @int.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PiercingShot: Deals @dex + 1d6 damage to a primary target and potentially to another target in an adjacent space.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Ambush: If you have not played any cards this turn other than Ambush, increase your damage by @wis for the next turn (stackable up to 2 times).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DoubleArrows: Deals @dex + 1d8 damage to up to two targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SupersonicShot:
Move the target by 2*@wis – X spaces in the desired direction.
Deals @cha + 2d6 – X damage, where X is the distance to the target.
(non-critical, unavoidable,
Xmin = 2)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PoisonedShot: Deals @dex + 1d4 damage and poisons the target, causing @wis damage per turn for 2 turns (stackable up to 2 times).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Trap: Immobilizes the target for their next turn and deals @int + 1d4 damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ReflexShot: Usable when you are about to take damage. Deals @dex + 1d6 damage, prioritized on the enemy attack (before the dice roll).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.TamedWolf:
Summons a wolf on an adjacent square, which acts immediately after your turn.
10 + @cha HP, @cha/3 + 1d6 damage(melee), @cha/2  + 4 movement
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ExplosiveShot: Deals @dex + 1d6 damage to a target and to adjacent targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EliteMarksman: Increases critical by @for + 10 until the end of the next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RainOfArrows: Increases critical by @for + 10 until the end of the next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ElementalMagic:
Discard a card if you are in combat.

Deal @int + (1d2 @wis) damage of an element of your choice, and 1d3 chance to apply the corresponding effect.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Vortex:
Deal 2 × @int + 1d8 damage, and the range is also increased by @int.

1d4 chance to apply an air effect that immobilizes the target for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RockThrow:
Deal X × @wis + Xd6 damage.

1d3 chance to apply an earth effect that reduces the target’s critical hit by 1 + @wis for 2 × @wis turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BurningHand:
Deal @int + 1d4 damage, then draw a card.

1d8 chance to burn the target, dealing 9 damage over 3 turns
(stackable up to 2 times).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GiantStalactite:
Deal 3 × @wis + 1d12 damage.

1d(6 – X) chance to freeze the target, reducing its action points by 4 for 4 turns.
(X is the number of Zeal points you choose to spend.)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.StanceShift:
On your turn, you may change your stance:
Transfer up to X Dodge points into Critical, or up to Y Critical points into Dodge (lasts 1 turn).
X = your Strength modifier
Y = your Constitution modifier
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BerserkerStance:
Draw a card.

For @str turns, lose X hit points and X Dodge at the start of your turn.
Increase your damage by X.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShieldRaise:
Draw a card.

Half-Dodge: You recover half the hit points you lost from the last attack.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Intervention:
Draw a card.
Teleport to the target that just took damage and take the damage in their place.

Your Constitution modifier increases the spell’s range.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EnchantedRapier:
Discard a card if you are in combat.

Deal 1 + 1d4 piercing damage.
Critical  bonus: @cha + @dex
1d2 chance to increase your range by 1.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.StatIllusion:
Temporarily transform your range bonus into either Critical, Instant Healing, or Mana.
Lasts 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FrenziedInspiration: Increase the damage of up to 3 targets by @cha for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Immateriality: The target cannot lose hit points or deal damage until the start of your next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Heal:
Discard a card if you are in combat. Outside of combat, this spell can only be used once per day.
Restore @con + (1d2 @wis) hit points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GoodAndEvil:
Transfer up to @con hit points from yourself to a target

OR

Transfer up to @int hit points from the target to yourself.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BlueBlood:
Sacrifice 2X hit points to gain X mana points.

Xmax = @con
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SolarStrike:
Reduce your @con and @wis to 0 for 3 turns.

Deal 4 × @int + 1d12 radiant damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Chastisements: If the target is cursed, deal 2 × @wis + 1d8 necrotic damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ChiMaster:
Discard X cards, gain X Zeal (Xmax = @str)
OR
Draw X cards, lose X Zeal (Xmax = @dex)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Uppercut:
Deal @dex damage, draw a card.
Costs @con fewer action points.
Force the target to attack you on its next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HealingPalm:
Restore (@dex + @wis) × X hit points to the target.
X max = 2
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Interruption:
Remove half of the target’s action points on its next turn. 
Can be played also at your turn
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Osteology:
Summons a level X skeleton using the sacrifice score.

Level X: Costs X sacrifice.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowSpell:
Discard a card if you are in combat.

Deals @wis + 1d4 necrotic damage to a target OR summons a level 1 skeleton if you target an adjacent square.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ArcaneStrike:
Deals @wis + 1d@wis necrotic damage to a target.
Summons a level 2 skeleton on an adjacent square.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BloodRitual:
Sacrifice a card.

Gain zeal equal to the number of skeletons in play.
This spell costs 2 fewer action points per @cha.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MorbidShift:
Destroy at least 1 skeleton.

Increase the movement of all other skeletons in play by @cha * sacrifice score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.AdjustedShot:
Usable after missing a critical roll.
Increases critical chance by @int (lasts 2 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SpikeTrap:
Deals @wis + 2dX piercing damage to a target that enters range (cannot critically hit),
where X is your critical score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PoisonTrap:
Deals 5 + @cha poison damage (cannot critically hit)

then deals X damage over 3 turns, where X is your critical score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RootedShot:
Do not move this turn.

Deals your movement score + 1d(2 × @dex) piercing damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RegainStrength:
Draw 2 cards.
Removes 2X critical for 2 turns. You regain X mana.
Xmax = @dex.
